_comment: Grid size is a function of object COUNT (PROMPT.md section 2.1 'grid size is a function of an object property/feature'; here the feature is the number of objects, a grid-level count rather than one object's extent, the extent case being crop_to_object.json). Each pair holds several distinct single-pixel objects; the output is a square canvas whose side equals the NUMBER of input objects, holding only the TOPMOST object placed at (0,0). Input grids are 5x5 with object counts 3 then 4, so the output sides (3, 4) are explained by neither a constant delta from the input size (deltas -2 vs -1), nor a constant absolute size, nor the selected object's own bbox extent (1x1): only by the object count. Exposes the gap left by the same/delta/constant/object_extent output-shape vocabulary (no object_count reading). Solved the intended way it merges into the one value-agnostic object_motion rule (covers +1), no new detector.
